rounds.response:
Hi Carol — thanks, that context helps a lot; here’s a compact, actionable setup you can implement this afternoon.  
Create Areas: Clients, Admin, Learning, Personal; under Clients make a Project per client named "Client — Project" and use Sections for milestones (Discovery, Design, Review, Delivery); for Admin use Projects like Proposals, Invoices, and Client Communications.  
Use tags for context (@email, @call, @design, @review), priority (P1/P2/P3 or ⭐), status (waiting, blocked, needs-client), and time estimate tags (15m/30m/2h) so you can filter for quick wins.  
Build smart lists: Today (due + flagged + scheduled), Upcoming 7 days grouped by project, Waiting On (tasks tagged waiting), and Someday; add a recurring Weekly Review task and keep templates for "New Project Checklist" and common admin workflows.  
Morning check‑in (5–7 min): inbox triage, pick 1–3 MITs and time‑block them, glance Waiting On and calendar; End‑of‑day (5 min): mark completes, move unfinished MITs to tomorrow, update client statuses and add any quick notes for next steps — I can draft example templates you can import if you’d like.
